breath.summary: Breath detection looks for the slow alternation of shorter and longer neighboring RR intervals: inhalation usually shortens RR, while exhalation lengthens it.
breath.parameterLink: Min RR delta sets the minimum change between neighboring intervals that counts as a breathing phase shift, while Max RR rejects overly long intervals so pauses and outliers do not distort detection.
breath.rPeakDescription:
R peaks on ECG
R peaks are time markers of heartbeat moments (R1-R3), defined by time or sample index in the raw data.

RR intervals
The distance between neighboring R peaks is measured in milliseconds: this is the RR interval.

BLE data
In a Heart Rate Measurement notification, the rr field contains several accumulated RR intervals between packets (up to 9 by the Bluetooth SIG specification).
breath.minDeltaDescription: Defines the minimum change between neighboring RR intervals that counts as a breathing phase shift. Used by breath detection to filter out minor fluctuations and noise.
breath.maxRrDescription: Defines the maximum allowed duration of a single RR interval. Used by breath detection to reject overly long intervals, pauses, and outliers.

deviceControl.connectTimeoutSecDescription: Defines how many seconds the UI waits for a BLE device to connect before marking the attempt as failed. Used during ECG and other BLE sensor connection attempts; it is not applied to EEG over COM.
deviceControl.eegStaleSecDescription: Defines how many seconds without fresh EEG data are allowed before the EEG stream is considered stale. Used by the BodyMonitor runtime: if no new data arrives longer than this interval, EEG is marked as disconnected.
